title: North Korea says it tested new torpedo system with AI capabilities
hook_text: North Korea claims new AI torpedo
script:
North Korea claims it successfully tested a new underwater torpedo system with AI capabilities.
State media confirmed the test occurred as part of their ongoing naval modernization efforts.
The country continues expanding its underwater strike capabilities to counter regional naval threats.
This announcement follows a series of recent weapons trials conducted by the government.
Military analysts are currently assessing the validity of these specific technical claims.
Would you trust AI to manage underwater weapon systems?
